text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her resolve thus renewed, Narita Taishin and I set our sights on the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An injury forces Winning Ticket to pull out of the race, leaving Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide to battle it out, one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Will Narita Taishin's powerful finishing sprint win? Or will Biwa Hayahide's winning equation bring her to victory?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtain is set to rise on the tense battle between the two racers.
